channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Zelenskyy urges urgent efforts in Ukraine to start Patriot production
item.description: US President Donald Trump gave his blessing earlier this week to domestic Ukrainian production of the missiles.

item.title: Iran says strikes hit southern areas, but US denies it carried attacks
item.description: Iranian state media reported that military headquarters were hit by strikes in Bushehr province and the city of Konarak.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz traffic plunges as US, Iran resume fighting
item.description: Brent crude holds steady despite a plunge in traffic in the critical waterway.

item.title: Gaza mourns aid worker killed by Israel who helped them see the World Cup
item.description: Israeli strike killed Mohammed al-Wahidi and three others on the eve of the Egypt vs Argentina match on Tuesday.

item.title: Iran war live: Uneasy calm in the Middle East after deadly attacks
item.description: American official says technical talks with Tehran continue and the United States wants to pursue diplomacy.

item.title: How Strait of Hormuz dispute led to latest US-Iran cycle of fighting
item.description: Clashing interpretations of vague memorandum of understanding language on Hormuz at heart of escalation, analysts say.

item.title: Huge crowds in Mashhad as Iran's late supreme leader is buried
item.description: Ali Khamenei was buried at the Imam Reza shrine, Iran's holiest Shia Muslim site, ending six days of public mourning ceremonies.

item.title: Palestinians mourn Gaza World Cup screenings organiser killed in Israeli strike
item.description: Aid worker Mohammed al-Wahidi had become a prominent humanitarian figure during the Israel-Hamas war.

item.title: What's next for Iran after the funeral of their late supreme leader?
item.description: The BBC's chief international correspondent looks at how Iran's new leadership will respond to several issues affecting the country.
